result:
Perfect! I have successfully completed the March 2026 revenue close for the Evergreen Bank implementation project. Here's what was accomplished:

## Summary of Actions

**Journal Entry Posted:** JE-00305
- **Date:** March 14, 2026 (upon customer acceptance)
- **Debit:** Deferred Revenue (2200) – USD 36,000
- **Credit:** Professional Services Revenue (4200) – USD 36,000
- **Support:** DOC-0184 (signed acceptance certificate) and DOC-0047 (contract)

## Revenue Recognition Reasoning (ASC 606)

| Milestone | Status | Amount | Recognition |
|-----------|--------|--------|--------------|
| **M1 – Solution Design** | ✅ Accepted 3/14/2026 | $36,000 | **RECOGNIZED** – Control transferred via signed acceptance certificate |
| **M2 – Build & Integration** | ❌ 80% complete, no UAT | $60,000 | **DEFERRED** – Control not transferred; no customer acceptance |
| **M3 – UAT & Go-Live** | ❌ Not started | $24,000 | **DEFERRED** – Control not transferred; no acceptance |

The contract explicitly ties revenue recognition to "Customer's written acceptance" of each distinct milestone deliverable. M1 alone was fully accepted in March (DOC-0184), satisfying the performance obligation. M2 and M3 remain deferred until their respective completions and acceptances occur (expected late April or later).

The complete analysis and supporting documentation have been submitted in the accompanying memo.
